findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION. Observed that cove base is missing along the wall and floor behind the downstairs bar. Discussed with PIC. Ensure coving is repaired to help prevent pest entry by the next routine inspection. 

6-201.13: (A) floor and wall junctures shall be coved and closed to no larger than 1mm (one thirty-second inch). (B) Floors in which water flush cleaning methods are used shall be provided with drains and be graded to drain. Floor and wall junctures shall be coved and SEALED.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
The facility has two ice bins, one upstairs and one downstairs, both containing mold and mildew.  Discussed with PIC.  Ensure the ice machine baffles are cleaned regularly.

4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.citation_text:
2-301.12 (C) (P) To avoid recontaminating their hands, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HAND WASHING.
The temporary hand washing station set up for the cooks outside by the grill did was set up using a gatorade pitcher where the button needed to be continuously depressed in order to disperse water. Temporary hand washing stations should be set up so that there is free flowing water and the user does not need to recontaminate their hands when using. The container was changed out with a switch type jug to correct.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
Observed a container of sausage to be stored above ready to eat foods (cheese) in the refrigerator. Make sure to properly store the food.
750-130(d) All food shall be stored properly in order to prevent cross-contamination.  Store ready to eat foods above or a way from raw foods.

findings.comment:

750-670 Equipment intended for in-place cleaning shall be designed for effective cleaning and sanitizing.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
750.650a - A) (R) White baffle in upstairs bar ice machine was soiled with mold buildup. Pits and grooves were observed along the bottom edge, and mold was starting to accumulate in the pits/grooves. Sand the edges of the baffle where disrepair is present to make the surface smooth and easily cleanable. Maintain the ice machine in a clean/sanitary condition.

B) (R) Fry baskets were observed to have extremely heavy buildup of grease and carbon. Some of the debris could be pulled off, but the club member stated the baskets are very hard to clean. The current condition is as good as they can get them in terms of cleaning. Replace the fry baskets, and maintain the new fry baskets in a clean/sanitary condition.

C) #10 can opener blade was observed to be soiled with old food debris/general buildup. The can opener was also very rusty. Food manager stated a hand-held can opener is typically used, and he was unsure as to the last time the #10 can opener was actually used. If the can opener will be kept on-site, then it needs to be maintained in a clean, sanitary condition. Repair or replace the can opener.

Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
750.800b - The pizza oven rack was soiled with carbon and food debris. The catch tray and general surfaces on the outside between the catch tray and the rack were soiled with general buildup.

Clean and sanitize the pizza oven between uses to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of debris. 
**During public events make sure all in-use utensils and equipment, such as knives, tongs, can opener, etc., are going through manual ware washing process up to every 4hrs after continuous use.**

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
750.830g - (R) Chlorine test strips are available for checking bleach solutions. However, Redi San Ready to Use (RTU) Hard Surface Sanitizer spray, is a quaternary ammonia (Quat) based product, and requires a different type of test strip. Bleach is used for sanitizing at the 3 part sink during ware washing, and the RTU spray is used for cleaning general surfaces (i.e. fryers etc.). Obtain quat test strips and use to check RTU sanitizer periodically to ensure product is at proper concentration (bottles tested at 200ppm with inspector's test strips). 

A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.
**NOTE: concentration for sanitizing at 3 part sink = 50ppm; concentration for sanitizer in spray bottles/sani-buckets = 100-200ppm. Use test strips to verify proper concentrations
RTU quat sanitizer must be 200-400ppm**

1. along the wall beneath the kitchen 3 part sink downstairs (dust/debris);
